summary.text: Craig Wilcox has represented the 32nd District in the Illinois Senate since October 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Wilcox served in the U.S. Air Force from 1989 to 2013 and on the McHenry County Board from 2016 to 2018.
Wilcox earned an electrical engineering degree at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 1989 and resides in McHenry.
